ayahs.1: By the sun and its morning brightness—
ayahs.2: By the moon as it follows it—in ordered rhythm across the sky—
ayahs.3: By the day as it reveals the sun—
ayahs.4: By the night as it veils it—
ayahs.5: By the heaven and the One who built it—
ayahs.6: By the earth and the One who spread it—
ayahs.7: By the soul and the One who proportioned it—
ayahs.8: Then inspired it with awareness of wrong and right—conscience and the capacity to choose are built into you.
ayahs.9: Successful is the one who purifies the soul—
ayahs.10: And ruined is the one who buries it in corruption.
ayahs.12: When the most wretched among them rose up—
ayahs.13: Though the messenger of Allah had warned them: Do not harm Allah's she-camel, and do not block her drink—
ayahs.14: They defied him and slaughtered her, so their Lord destroyed them for their sin and levelled them—
ayahs.15: And He did not fear the consequence—no power can hold Allah to account for His justice.
